title: Serpentine Whisper Chain (gold tone)
metal: 18k gold tone (PVD 18K gold tone coating on surgical stainless steel), warm buttery high polish, one tone only. The rhodium silver tone version is a separate listing.
lock: 18k gold tone. 1 smooth round snake chain, 2 mm thick, 40 cm plus a 5 cm curb-link extender and lobster clasp. At the front, 1 cushion-cut clear cubic zirconia, 10 mm (5x the chain's thickness), in an open 4-prong ball-tipped basket fixed directly under 1 plain folded bail. Must stay 1 stone in 4 prongs, basket straight on the bail, never a halo, jump ring or larger stone.
morph: The pendant. Image models add a jump ring between the bail and the basket (the silver twin's b04-4h was held for exactly this), wrap the stone in a halo or extra stones, swell it past 10 mm (in the listing photos the stone is 5 to 5.5x the chain's thickness, never 8-10x), recut it as a sharp-cornered princess, radiant or emerald cut or a round brilliant, or swap the 4 ball-tipped prongs for 6 prongs or a closed bezel. Second: the snake chain. In gold tone it most often drifts to a flat herringbone, and also to a cable, box, rope or curb chain, or thickens into a choker cord. Third: the metal drifts brassy, orange or rose. Fourth: listing photo 03 shows a second snake-chain loop with its own clasp; a model given that photo may add a bracelet.
sizeMm: Listed: chain 400 mm plus a 50 mm extender (size guide: give or take 10 mm), 2 mm snake chain, 10 g, stone a cushion of about 10 mm. Measured on the packshot (01) and plinth detail (02): stone width 5 to 5.5x the chain's diameter, which matches 10 mm on 2 mm; the plain bail is about 3.5 mm wide (a third of the stone's width). Estimated, not listed: the whole drop from the chain to the bottom of the basket is about 15 mm; the basket stands about 5 mm deep behind the stone. There is no worn photo in this listing. On the body (size guide 06): 40 cm sits at the base of the neck, the stone in the notch between the collarbones; 45 cm on the extender drops it a little lower, well above the 50 cm mid-chest line. It is not a choker (the guide puts choker at 36 cm). Referents: the stone is half a Rs 1 coin (20 mm), about a little fingernail, about the length of a green cardamom pod's body (the pod in listing photo 03 is about 1.5x the stone's height); the chain is as thick as a strand of spaghetti.
refNotes: Reused the ads-500 ids from products.md and ads-500/build/refs.json after checking that they match the current listing. Ref 1 (pack) = listing 01, the same Shopify file serpentine-whisper-chain-0_51e2b606 recorded in refs_src.json; mean pixel difference against ads-500/build/refs/serpentine-whisper-chain__pack.jpg is about 1.0/255. It is the clearest view of the whole build: snake chain, tube end caps, curb extender, lobster clasp, flat oblong tag, bail and basket. Ref 2 (detail) = listing 02, file serpentine-whisper-chain-3; difference against __detail.jpg is about 1.1/255. It is the best close view of the bail fixed straight on the basket (no jump ring), the 4 ball-tipped prongs, the cushion's rounded corners and the chain's chevron ridges. It also shows scale: the chain is 2 mm against the 10 mm stone, about 5x. The listing has no worn photo, so for a body-scale prompt describe the size guide (06) in words; no new import was made. Do not use 03 as a construction ref (extra bracelet loop, missing clasp, closed engraved gallery). 04 (linen macro) is a good third ref for prongs and the open gallery if a macro shot needs one; it was not imported.
claims: Waterproof, Tarnish Free, Hypoallergenic: all 3 are tagged. The care text backs the first 2 ('Waterproof and tarnish free, so daily wear and water are fine'); hypoallergenic rests on the tag alone. Water imagery is allowed for this piece. The description also says PVD 'stands up to sweat and keeps its colour much longer' than regular plating; paraphrase that, never as 'lasts forever'.
variants: 1 variant: Default Title, SKU YF8439, stock 20 (exactly at the floor), 18k gold tone. Show it; every product photo shows this variant. The rhodium silver tone twin is a separate listing (serpentine-whisper-chain-silver, Rs 899, stock 23). Never put them in the same frame, camp or price line: the same build is priced Rs 400 apart. At stock 20 this piece is never the anchor or the card 5; give it a named swap.
copyNotes: Use: 18k gold tone, PVD 18k gold tone, surgical stainless steel, snake chain, cushion-cut clear cubic zirconia, solitaire-style, one stone, 2 mm, 40 cm + 5 cm, 10 mm, 10 g, waterproof, tarnish free, hypoallergenic, ships in a Naira Petite box. Adapt the listing's own lines to the house rule: 'One stone, one smooth line of gold tone.' and 'one clear point of focus'. Price Rs 1,299 (compare-at Rs 2,169). Card line: '18k gold tone · 40 cm + 5 cm'. Avoid: diamond, solitaire diamond, solid gold, real gold, 18k gold or 'gold' alone as the metal, gold-filled, vermeil, sterling, 'fine gold basket' as written (say 'fine gold-tone basket'), halo, pave, princess, radiant, emerald or round cut, cable, box, rope, curb or herringbone chain (the extender is the only curb links), choker (40 cm sits at the base of the neck), pendant set, bracelet, huggie, emerald-green cubic zirconia, and 'anti-tarnish' (say tarnish free, the tagged word). No review, rating or customer count.
story: One stone, one smooth line of gold tone: a poured stroke of liquid metal with a single drop of light at the bottom. The snake chain has no links to catch on, so it reads as one continuous gold line, like honey running off a dipper. The 10 mm cushion hangs at the end of that line like the bead of honey just before it falls. It is lovable as a solitaire-style ring worn at the throat: one clear point, nothing to style around, waterproof, so it stays on through the shower and the sea. Rhymes, in order of strength: (1) the Nagamani, the jewel a cobra is said to carry; a serpent of gold holding one clear stone is the myth made wearable ('The serpent kept one jewel. So can you.'). (2) Dhaage wali mishri, rock-sugar crystals grown on a thread; a clear faceted crystal on a gold-coloured string is almost edible ('Almost edible.', the RHYME line that won 2.75x on Stories). (3) Elaichi: the listing's own photo lays a green cardamom pod beside the stone, and they are the same size, so it works as a scale-proof rhyme. (4) A honey dipper with one drop forming. (5) Champa flowers with golden hearts, a prior colour plate (49, 'Gold at heart.', not founder-rated). (6) A full stop, or the dot of an exclamation mark (the c05 punctuation camp). (7) One diya flame in a dark room for NIGHT and Diwali, an ice cube in a glass of nimbu pani for DAY. It is the warm twin of the silver Serpentine (give the gold, keep the silver), but never in the same camp. Best on warm saturated grounds (shagun red, terracotta, oxblood, plum, black) where the clear stone is the brightest point and the 18k gold tone reads warm, not brassy. At the stock floor (20), so it plays a supporting card, never the anchor.

photos.src: serpentine-whisper-chain-0_51e2b606 (alt 'Serpentine Whisper Chain'); 1649 px, resized to 1400
photos.what: Packshot on a cream plaster block, top three-quarter view. The whole chain is laid in an open loop. It shows a finely ridged round snake chain, tube end caps, a curb-link extender of about 10 links, a lobster clasp, and a flat oblong tag with 2 holes on the other end. The pendant sits at the front: 1 clear cushion in 4 ball-tipped corner prongs, an open basket gallery with rectangular windows (2 rails), and a plain folded bail fixed to the basket's top with no jump ring. Stone width is about 5.5x the chain's diameter. This is the best construction view and is the same as the ads-500 pack ref.

Plinth detail: the chain runs over the block's top edge and the pendant hangs against the front face. It is the sharpest view of the bail. A smooth folded loop narrows to a short tab soldered straight onto the basket's back rail, with no jump ring. It also shows the 4 ball-tipped prongs, the cushion's rounded corners and crushed-ice facets, the side gallery window, and the chain's chevron scale ridges. Chain to stone is about 1:4.5-5. Same as the ads-500 detail ref.

Styled flat lay on a terracotta plaster ground with 1 green cardamom pod beside the stone (a RHYME prop). WARNING: it shows a second, smaller snake-chain loop with its own lobster clasp and curb extender, which looks like a matching bracelet and is not part of this listing. The necklace's own lobster clasp is missing (one end cap is bare; the other carries the extender and the tag). The basket's lower rail reads as a closed engraved band, not open windows. It is likely generated. Use it as a mood and scale rhyme (the pod is about the stone's size), never as a construction ref.

Macro on natural loose-weave linen with raw threads, warm side light. It is the best view of the 4 ball-tipped prongs at the corners, the open gallery (top rail, lower rail, rectangular windows), the bail and the cushion's facets with a small sparkle. The bail joins the basket directly. The construction is consistent with 01 and 02.

finish: Warm, buttery, high-polish 18k gold tone (yellow, never orange, brassy or rose). The snake chain's fine chevron scale ridges carry one continuous line of light. The tube end caps, bail and prongs are smooth mirror surfaces. The stone is a clear, fully faceted cushion with a crushed-ice pattern, crisp white sparkle and faint fire.
